Wally

Manny Ortega introduces Cindy McAllister to Candace "Wally" Wallace Features MANNY ORTEGA. Contains 1 dialogue exchanges. [1]

CINDY MCALLISTER: Nice to meet you, "Wally". Any special skills I should know about for job placement.

WALLY": Are you serious? [1]

CINDY MCALLISTER: Yes.

WALLY": Okay, um, engineer, computers, helped run a nuclear power plant for the last six months. So, infrastructure and power. [1]

CINDY MCALLISTER: How are you at puzzles?

WALLY": Great. Love them. The more impossible to solve the better. [1]

CINDY MCALLISTER: I recovered this encrypted file from a Hunter drone, haven't been able to break the encryption, maybe you could take a stab at it.

WALLY": Oh, sure. Is that my job, now? [1]

CINDY MCALLISTER: If you can crack the encryption.

WALLY": Sweet. I was a little worried you were gonna put me to work shucking corn or some bullshit. [1]

CINDY MCALLISTER: You're an engineer. If you're going into food production I'd put you on the aquaponics system.
